title: T46 playbooks: animated tier in validate_pack and the pack generator (0.4.0)
head: t46-animated-tier
body:
## What

playbooks' half of T46 (animated tier for avatar packs), per `docs/t46/contract.md` §1/§2/§3/§4/§8.

- `src/garage/avatars/grid.py`: `STATES`/`COLS`/`FPS` documented as the standard-tier default shape; new constants `MIN_FRAMES`/`MAX_FRAMES` (4-12), `MIN_ANIMATED_FPS`/`MAX_ANIMATED_FPS` (6-12), `MAX_IDLE_VARIANTS` (8).
- `src/garage/avatars/validate.py` (`validate_pack`): accepts optional `tier` (`standard`/`animated`/absent), optional `frames` (4-12, must equal `grid.columns`), optional `fps` (6-12, must equal `grid.fps`), and extra `grid.rows` entries — one or more `idle_variant_1..idle_variant_8` (numbered from 1, no gaps, at most 8 per §8.7) then optionally `celebrate` — allowed only under the animated tier. `tier: animated` is refused without at least one `idle_variant_N` row **and** a `celebrate` row (§8.5). Every new rule reuses the existing `grid` error code with paths `tier`, `frames`, `fps`, `grid.rows` per §3. A pack with none of these keys — Beacon included — validates byte-for-byte exactly as before.
- `src/garage/avatars/pack.py` (`render_pack`): gains optional keyword-only `frames`, `fps` and `extra_states` to emit an animated-tier pack (manifest gains `tier`/`frames`/`fps` and the extra `grid.rows`/gifs only when any of them is passed); called with none of them it still emits today's plain pack unchanged, byte-for-byte (existing `test_beacon_rebuild_matches_shipped` unchanged and still passing). `save_gif`/`build_preview` generalized to take the row list/column count/frame rate as parameters instead of hardcoded constants.
- `avatars/tools/build_pack.py` untouched — it only forwards a `Character` module to `render_pack`, so no CLI surface needed changing (noted in CHANGELOG).
- No signed library index is built anywhere in `playbooks` (confirmed by search) — nothing here to add `tier` to; that is agent-core's `avatar_library.py`, per the shared contract.
- Version 0.3.0 → 0.4.0 in `pyproject.toml` and `uv.lock`'s own `playbooks` package entry (via `uv lock`). `CHANGELOG.md` gets a new entry under `## Unreleased` (this repo's changelog has no per-version headings anywhere — checked with `grep '^## '` — so the existing T26 lines were left in place rather than invented a heading convention that doesn't exist here; flagged below for Braden).

## Checks

<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check

Mutant → killing test:

All 8 mutants applied by editing source, run under `pytest`, then reverted (never `git checkout`/`git restore`/`git stash`); WIP committed first, squashed into this one commit after.

1. Accept a `frames` value outside 4-12 (`frames_out_of_range = False`) → `test_frames_outside_range_refused` (isolated case: columns == frames, still out of range).
2. Accept an `fps` value outside 6-12 (drop the range check) → `test_fps_outside_range_refused[5]` (isolated case: `fps == grid.fps`, still out of range).
3. Accept `frames != grid.columns` (drop the mismatch check) → `test_frames_mismatched_with_columns_refused`.
4. Accept `fps != grid.fps` (drop the mismatch check) → `test_fps_mismatched_with_grid_fps_refused`.
5. Drop the fallback — require `idle_variant`/`celebrate` even for a standard-tier pack instead of falling back to today's shape → `test_shipped_beacon`, `test_old_pack_has_no_extra_rows_and_falls_back`, `test_beacon_rebuild_matches_shipped`, `test_non_beacon_character_and_magenta_gif` (4 tests failed).
6. Accept `tier: animated` without a `celebrate` row → `test_animated_without_celebrate_refused`.
7. Accept extra `grid.rows` on a standard-tier pack → `test_extra_rows_on_standard_pack_refused`, `test_extra_rows_explicit_standard_tier_refused` (2 tests failed).
8. Accept a 9th (or later) `idle_variant_N` row (drop the §8.7 cap, added mid-review per the coordinator's contract update) → `test_animated_pack_with_ninth_idle_variant_refused`.

All 8 mutants killed; no survivors. `git diff` against the pre-mutation WIP commit was empty after each restore.

## Tests

```
uv sync
  Resolved 37 packages
uv run --no-sync pytest -q
  201 passed
uv run --no-sync ruff check .
  All checks passed!
uv run --no-sync ruff format --check .
  58 files already formatted
uv run --no-sync mypy --strict src/
  Success: no issues found in 19 source files
```

New/changed tests: `tests/test_avatars_validate.py` (frames/fps in-range + out-of-range + mismatch, invalid/valid `tier` values, animated pack with 1/2/8 idle variants + celebrate, animated without celebrate/idle-variant/either, extra rows on a standard pack — both tier-absent and `tier: standard` — 6 malformed `grid.rows` shapes, a 9th idle variant, and an explicit "old pack falls back" check); `tests/test_avatars_pack.py` (a synthetic animated pack built and validated with no image files committed, default output unchanged, out-of-range `frames`/`fps` raise in the generator).

Open for Braden: this repo's `CHANGELOG.md` has never used per-version headings (only one `## Unreleased` heading exists in the whole file, with version numbers noted inline per bullet, e.g. "(0.3.0, decision #89)") — so I did not move the T26 lines under a new `## 0.4.0` heading as the ticket suggested, since that would depart from the repo's actual convention. Said so here rather than inventing one.
